language_annotation.method: Contextual annotation after inspection of the pinned native scan. Historical East Slavic vernacular (orv, provisional; no exact recension inferred) for the sustained Ruthenian-language witness B and its variants, grounded in Franko's explicit statement on I/176 (nearly vernacular, independent reworkings in two manuscripts, Drohobych dated 1742) and forms in I/172–175 such as будовати, двох, але, поневаж, мовит, лос, зостал, зийшла. Church Slavonic retained for inherited title and witness A. Editorial Ukrainian, Latin apparatus abbreviations and unresolved sigla distinguished. Printed superscript apparatus labels, including paired delimiters, and asterisk note markers are zxx; historic titlo numerals remain contextual. No inferred critical-apparatus relations. No new diplomatic transcription.
